answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if peers prove duplicate control. Like a juniper planted per identity, every extra fake needs its own deposit, so spawning thousands drains capital fast. Honest agents treat the staked registry as a haven, while auditors carry a lantern: linked wallets sharing funds or timing trigger review and forfeiture. Attack cost scales linearly with fake count; honest cost stays one stake.
